# meca-cristal-agua (ORM, docs/MECANISMOS_ADULTO.md, family F2, Templo del Agua), A: both ADULT at the entrance; a crystal switch hit for real with the hammer, then room 08's shutter.
# Run with --transport ws; switches below (#! switches). Needs daurosk branch orm/meca-adulto (the `key` test
# command) on orm/test8 (the `warp ... adult|child`, LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS). Generated by
# tools/harness/meca_adulto.py: change the table there, not this file. Positions from the Banc, not walked yet:
# a 'test place ...: failed' or a 'goto timed out' is the scenario's gap, not the code's.
# Mutant: the same run without LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS turns the 'never' lines of the adult list red.
#! noload
#! start coop: test warp done
#! saves 15-agua
#! switches LICHII_COOP_PUPPET=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_FLAGS=1,LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS=shared_dungeon_adult.txt,LICHII_COOP_CHEATS=1
#! timeout 227
#! expect B coop: puppet: P\d: create CoopPuppet_Adult
#! expect A coop: test assign Hammer: set within prep..end
#! expect A coop: flags debug: (bool 0x[0-9a-f]{8} \(entry|key64 0x[0-9a-f]+ \(record) \d+\) 0 -> 1 within golpea..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: (bool 0x[0-9a-f]{8} \(entry|key64 0x[0-9a-f]+ \(record) \d+\) 0 -> 1 within golpea..end
#! expect A coop: test flag WaterTemple_Room08_OpenShutterBySwitch \(0x59906535\) = 1: queued within abierta..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0x59906535 \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within abierta..end
mark start
warp WaterTemple WaterTemple_FromLakeHylia adult
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark after
wait 600                # the other game lands too: puppets made
mark prep
give PouchData.Item_Hammer.StockNum
assign Hammer
wait 300
mark golpea
place -28.50 112.10 2.00   # 1.5 m from Obj_SwitchHit_A_06 b17c9f37828304c9
wait 240
toward -28.50 3.50 20   # face it
press ZR 10   # the hammer
wait 360
mark abierta
flag WaterTemple_Room08_OpenShutterBySwitch 1
wait 300
wait 300
mark end
